Ella rarely goes to the gym.
items.why: 일주일에 7일은 '매일'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: The answer is “twice a month.” Which question fits?
o: How often does he visit his grandparents?
How long does he visit his grandparents?
How far does he visit his grandparents?
How much does he visit his grandparents?
items.why: 횟수나 빈도를 묻는 말은 How often이에요.

items.q: Which sentence describes a daily habit?
o: I am walking my dog now.
I walk my dog every evening.
I will walk my dog tomorrow.
items.why: 반복되는 습관은 every evening과 함께 현재형으로 나타내요.

items.q: Which sentence states a general fact?
o: The cow is eating grass now.
items.why: 늘 사실인 내용은 현재형으로 말해요.

items.q: Which sentence is about a regular schedule?
o: The train is leaving right now.
The train left at six yesterday.
The first train leaves at six every day.
items.why: 매일 정해진 시간표는 현재형으로 나타내요.

items.q: Which time expression usually goes with a simple present habit?
items.why: every weekend는 반복을 나타내서 현재형과 쓰이고, 나머지는 과거를 나타내요.

items.q: ____ plays the guitar.
items.why: plays는 3인칭 단수 주어와 쓰므로 My cousin이 알맞아요.

items.q: Which subject goes with “don't”?
items.why: don't는 복수 주어(The students)와 써요. 나머지는 모두 3인칭 단수예요.

items.q: Which subject goes with “doesn't”?
items.why: doesn't는 3인칭 단수 주어와 써요.

items.q: My parents and I ____ dinner at six.
items.why: My parents and I는 복수 주어이므로 동사원형을 써요.

items.q: Which pronoun replaces “Mina and Jisu” in “Mina and Jisu walk to school.”?
items.why: 두 사람은 복수이므로 they로 바꿔요.

items.q:
다음 문장의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
“He doesn't walk to school.”
items.why: doesn't walk는 '걸어가지 않는다'는 현재의 부정이에요.

items.q:
다음 문장의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
“Does she speak Korean?”
items.why: Does she speak ~?는 현재의 일반적인 사실을 묻는 질문이에요.

items.q: 영어로 “우리 할머니는 매일 아침 산책해요.”를 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: My grandmother is walks every morning.
items.why: 3인칭 단수 주어이므로 walks를 써요.

items.q: 영어로 “준은 주말마다 영화를 봐요.”를 바르게 옮긴 것은?
o: Jun watch a movie every weekend.
Jun watches a movie every weekend.
Jun watchs a movie every weekend.
Jun watching a movie every weekend.
items.why: watch는 -ch로 끝나므로 watches가 돼요.

items.q: Ben's week: Monday swimming, Wednesday piano, Friday swimming. Which sentence is true?
o: Ben plays the piano on Friday.
Ben swims on Monday and Friday.
Ben plays the piano every day.
items.why: 표에 따르면 수영은 월요일과 금요일, 피아노는 수요일이에요.

items.q: School lunch: Monday noodles, Tuesday rice, Wednesday noodles. Which sentence is true?
o: The school serves rice on Monday.
The school serves noodles every day.
The school serves rice on Wednesday.
The school serves noodles on Monday and Wednesday.
items.why: 국수는 월요일과 수요일, 밥은 화요일에 나와요.

items.q: Hana wakes up at 6:30, runs at 7:00, and eats breakfast at 7:30. Which sentence is true?
o: Hana eats breakfast before she runs.
items.why: 달리기는 7시, 아침 식사는 7시 30분이므로 아침 식사 전에 달려요.

items.q: In “Does she do her homework?”, which word is the main verb?
items.why: Does는 의문문을 만드는 조동사이고, 진짜 동사(본동사)는 do예요.

items.q: Which sentence uses “does” as the main verb?
o: She does her homework after school.
How does he go to school?
items.why: 첫 문장의 does는 '하다'라는 뜻의 본동사이고, 나머지는 의문문·부정문을 만드는 조동사예요.

items.q: Where ____ your parents work?
items.why: your parents는 복수이므로 Where do ~?를 쓰고, are/is 뒤에는 동사원형이 올 수 없어요.

items.title: A Day at the Bakery
items.text: Mr. Han owns a small bakery near my school. He gets up at four every morning because bread takes a long time to make. First, he mixes flour, water, and salt. Then he puts the bread in a hot oven. His wife, Mrs. Han, arrives at six and cleans the shop. At seven the first customers come in. Most of them buy bread for breakfast, but some students buy sweet rolls on their way to school. The bakery closes at three, and Mr. Han goes home to sleep for a few hours.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How students choose food on their way to school
How Mr. Han spends a normal day at his bakery
Why bread takes so long to bake in a hot oven
How Mrs. Han cleans the shop every morning
qs.why: 글 전체가 제빵사 한 씨의 하루 일과를 순서대로 설명하고 있어요.

qs.q: Why does Mr. Han get up at four?
o: The first customers arrive before five.
His wife wants him to clean the shop.
Making bread needs a lot of time.
qs.why: 본문에 'bread takes a long time to make'라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does Mr. Han do right after he mixes the flour, water, and salt?
o: He puts the bread in a hot oven.
He sells sweet rolls to students.
qs.why: First 다음에 Then he puts the bread in a hot oven이 이어져요.

qs.q: In the passage, the word “customers” means people who ____.
qs.why: 문맥상 빵을 사러 오는 사람들이므로 customers는 '손님'이에요.

qs.q: What can we guess about Mr. Han's day?
o: He works until late at night and never rests.
He opens the shop only on weekends and holidays.
He starts very early and finishes in the afternoon.
He sleeps in the shop for most of the day.
qs.why: 새벽 4시에 일어나서 3시에 문을 닫고 집에 가서 자므로 일찍 시작해서 오후에 끝낸다고 추론할 수 있어요.

items.title: An Email from Ana
items.text: Hi Jina, Thank you for your last email. You asked about my weekends, so here they are. On Saturdays I help my dad at his flower shop. He opens the shop at nine, and I water the plants. After lunch I usually practice the violin for an hour. On Sundays my family visits my grandmother. She lives in a small village, and she makes delicious noodle soup for us. My brother doesn't like vegetables, so he always eats the noodles first! What do you do on weekends? Write soon. Ana

qs.q: Why does Ana write this email?
o: To invite Jina to her father's shop
To say sorry for a late reply
To answer Jina's question and ask her one back
To tell Jina about a new violin
qs.why: Ana는 Jina가 물은 주말에 대해 답하고, 마지막에 같은 질문을 되물어요.

qs.q: What does Ana do at the flower shop?
o: She opens the shop at nine.
She cooks lunch for her dad.
qs.why: I water the plants라고 나와요. 가게를 여는 사람은 아빠예요.

qs.q: In the passage, “she” in “she makes delicious noodle soup” refers to ____.
qs.why: 바로 앞 문장의 my grandmother를 가리켜요.

qs.q: What can we guess about Ana's brother?
o: He cooks the noodle soup for the whole family.
He likes noodles more than vegetables.
He lives in the village with his grandmother.
He plays the violin with Ana every Saturday.
qs.why: 채소를 좋아하지 않아 국수를 먼저 먹는다는 내용에서 국수를 더 좋아한다고 추론할 수 있어요.

qs.q: The word “delicious” is closest in meaning to ____.
qs.why: 맛있는 수프라는 문맥이므로 delicious는 tasty(맛있는)와 뜻이 비슷해요.

items.title: Our Class Pet
items.text: Our class has a pet hamster named Coco. She lives in a cage near the window. Coco sleeps during the day and wakes up in the evening, so we don't see her run much at school. Every Monday, two students clean her cage. Every day, our teacher gives her seeds and a little fruit. Coco never eats candy because sweet food is bad for her. On Fridays, one student takes her home for the weekend. Everyone wants to be the next one!

qs.q: What is the best title for this passage?
qs.why: 글 전체가 반 친구들이 햄스터를 돌보는 방법을 이야기하고 있어요.

qs.q: How often do students clean Coco's cage?
qs.why: Every Monday, two students clean her cage라고 했으므로 일주일에 한 번이에요.

qs.q: Why doesn't Coco eat candy?
o: Sweet food is bad for her.
She likes seeds much more than candy.
The teacher hides the candy in a drawer.
She is asleep when the candy is served.
qs.why: because sweet food is bad for her라고 이유가 나와요.

qs.q: Why don't the students see Coco run much at school?
o: She is too small to run very fast.
Her cage is too far away from the room.
She goes home with a student every day.
She is mostly asleep during school hours.
qs.why: 낮에 자고 저녁에 깨어나기 때문에 학교에서는 많이 뛰는 모습을 못 봐요.

qs.q: What does the last sentence show about the students?
o: They are tired of cleaning her cage.
They are afraid of the small animal.
They are excited to take Coco home.
They want to give her sweet food.
qs.why: Everyone wants to be the next one이라는 말에서 Coco를 집에 데려가고 싶어 한다는 걸 알 수 있어요.

items.title: Why Bees Dance
items.text: Honey bees do not talk, but they share information in a special way. When a worker bee finds flowers with a lot of food, she flies back to the hive and dances. The dance shows the other bees where the flowers are. If the flowers are close, the bee moves in a small circle. If the flowers are far away, she moves in a straight line and shakes her body. The faster she dances, the closer the food is. Then the other workers leave the hive and follow her directions. This system helps the whole group find food quickly.

qs.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Bees build their hives near many flowers.
Bees cannot find any flowers alone.
Bees use dances to tell others where food is.
Bees dance in order to stay warm.
qs.why: 글 전체가 꿀벌이 춤으로 먹이의 위치를 알려 주는 방법을 설명해요.

qs.q: What does a bee do when the flowers are far away?
o: She moves in a small circle slowly.
She stays quietly inside the hive.
She flies around the whole hive twice.
She moves in a straight line and shakes her body.
qs.why: 먼 곳의 꽃일 때는 직선으로 움직이며 몸을 흔든다고 나와요.

qs.q: What happens after the dance?
o: The other workers follow her directions.
The first bee goes to sleep at once.
The flowers start to grow quickly.
The hive moves to a new place nearby.
qs.why: Then the other workers leave the hive and follow her directions라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does a very fast dance tell the other bees?
qs.why: The faster she dances, the closer the food is라고 나와요.

qs.q: Why did the writer write this passage?
o: To persuade people to keep bees at home
To explain how a group of insects shares information
To tell a funny story about one bee
To show step by step how honey is made
qs.why: 글쓴이는 꿀벌이 서로 정보를 나누는 방식을 설명하려고 썼어요.

items.title: The Friday Night Market
items.text: Every Friday evening, the night market in my town opens at six. Dozens of stalls sell food, clothes, and toys. My favorite stall sells grilled corn. The owner, Mr. Seo, always gives me an extra piece when the line is short. My mother prefers the tea stall, where an old lady makes tea with fresh ginger. My little brother only goes to the toy stall. He looks at the toys for an hour, but he never buys anything because he saves his money for a bigger toy.

qs.q: When does the night market open?
qs.why: Every Friday evening ... opens at six라고 나와요.

qs.q: When does Mr. Seo give the writer an extra piece of corn?
o: When there are few people in line
When the writer's mother is there
qs.why: when the line is short에서 줄이 짧을 때라는 걸 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, “prefers” is closest in meaning to ____.
qs.why: 어머니는 여러 가판대 중에서 찻집을 더 좋아한다는 문맥이에요.

qs.q: Why does the writer's brother never buy anything?
o: He is saving money for a bigger toy.
The toys are all too old for him.
He doesn't really like the toy stall.
His mother says no to him every time.
qs.why: he saves his money for a bigger toy라고 나와요.

qs.q: How does the writer feel about the market?
qs.why: 좋아하는 가판대와 가족의 취향을 즐겁게 소개하는 어조예요.

items.title: A Zookeeper's Job
items.text: Sora wants to be a zookeeper, so she reads about the job. Zookeepers start their day by checking every animal. They give food to the animals and clean their homes. Some animals eat only once a day, but others eat many times. A zookeeper also watches how the animals behave. If an animal does not play or eat, the keeper calls a doctor. In the afternoon, many keepers talk to visitors about the animals. It is hard work, but zookeepers say it is worth it because they love animals.

qs.q: What do zookeepers do first each day?
qs.why: Zookeepers start their day by checking every animal이라고 나와요.

qs.q: Which statement is true?
o: All animals eat once a day.
Some animals eat many times a day.
Keepers never clean the animals' homes.
Visitors feed the animals each morning.
qs.why: Some animals eat only once a day, but others eat many times라고 나와요.

qs.q: Why does a keeper call a doctor when an animal does not eat?
qs.why: 놀거나 먹지 않는 것은 아프다는 신호일 수 있다고 추론할 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does “it is worth it” mean here?
o: The job pays a lot of money to them.
The work takes only a short time each day.
The animals are always easy to feed.
The hard work is good enough for them.
qs.why: 일은 힘들지만 동물을 사랑해서 그럴 만한 가치가 있다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: A zookeeper's job has many duties.
Animals eat many kinds of different food.
Sora is going to visit a big zoo.
qs.why: 글 전체가 사육사가 하는 여러 가지 일을 설명하고 있어요.

items.title: Dinner at My House
items.text: In my family, dinner is the most important time of the day. We eat at seven, and nobody uses a phone at the table. My father cooks on weekdays, and my mother cooks on weekends. My sister sets the table, and I wash the dishes. While we eat, each person talks about the best part of his or her day. My grandfather, who lives with us, always tells a funny story. Sometimes the story is so funny that my sister laughs and cannot finish her soup.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How to cook soup for guests
Why phones are bad for children
qs.why: 글 전체가 저녁 식사 시간의 규칙과 분위기를 소개하고 있어요.

qs.q: Who cooks dinner on weekends?
qs.why: My mother cooks on weekends라고 나와요.

qs.q: What do people talk about during dinner?
o: The best part of their day
qs.why: each person talks about the best part of his or her day라고 나와요.

qs.q: Which rule does the family have at the table?
qs.why: nobody uses a phone at the table이라고 나와요.

qs.q: Why can't the sister finish her soup sometimes?
o: She has to wash the dishes.
qs.why: 할아버지의 이야기가 너무 웃겨서 웃느라 수프를 다 못 먹어요.

items.title: A Year on an Apple Farm
items.text: Mr. Kim grows apples on a small farm. In spring, white flowers cover the trees, and he works hard to protect them from the cold. In summer, he waters the trees and takes away some small apples so that the others grow big. In autumn, the whole family picks the apples. They put the best ones in boxes and send them to the city. In winter, the farm is quiet. Mr. Kim fixes his tools and plans for next year. He says a farmer never really rests, but winter is the slowest time.

qs.q: What does Mr. Kim do in summer?
o: He picks all the apples with his family.
He waters the trees and removes some small apples.
He protects the white flowers from the cold.
He fixes his tools and plans for next year.
qs.why: 여름에는 나무에 물을 주고 작은 사과 몇 개를 따 줘요.

qs.q: Why does Mr. Kim take away some small apples?
o: Because the city doesn't want small ones
So that the other apples can grow big
Because the flowers need more space
qs.why: so that the others grow big라고 목적이 나와요.

qs.q: When is the farm the quietest?
qs.why: In winter, the farm is quiet라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does “a farmer never really rests” suggest?
o: A farmer sleeps only a very little.
A farmer is never really tired.
A farmer works only during the summer.
A farmer always has some work to do.
qs.why: 겨울에도 도구를 고치고 계획을 세우는 등 늘 할 일이 있다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Apples grow best in very cold weather.
City people need much more fruit.
A farmer's work changes with the seasons.
Farms are quiet in every season.
qs.why: 계절마다 달라지는 농부의 일을 설명하는 글이에요.

items.title: Grandma's Phone
items.text: My grandmother has a smartphone, but she uses it in a simple way. She calls her friends in the morning and checks the weather before she goes to the market. Every evening she watches a short cooking video. She doesn't play games because she thinks they waste time. Now she sends pictures of her garden to the family every Sunday. My little cousin laughs when she holds the phone upside down, but Grandma just smiles and says, "Learning is never too late."

qs.q: What does Grandma do before she goes to the market?
qs.why: checks the weather before she goes to the market이라고 나와요.

qs.q: Why doesn't Grandma play games?
o: She has no time at night.
Her cousin plays them for her.
qs.why: she thinks they waste time이라고 이유가 나와요.

qs.q: When does Grandma send pictures of her garden?
qs.why: Now she sends pictures ... every Sunday라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does Grandma's last sentence show about her?
o: She is angry at her little cousin.
She wants to buy a newer phone.
She thinks phones are quite useless.
qs.why: 'Learning is never too late'라는 말에서 늦게라도 배우려는 긍정적인 태도를 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How an older woman uses her phone
Why children laugh at old people
Which apps are the best for cooking
How to play games on a phone
qs.why: 할머니가 스마트폰을 쓰는 방식을 소개하는 글이에요.

items.title: Sleep and School
items.text: Doctors say that students between twelve and fifteen need eight to ten hours of sleep. However, many students sleep only six or seven hours because they study late or use their phones in bed. A lack of sleep makes it hard to pay attention in class, and it can also change a person's mood. To sleep better, experts suggest a few simple habits. First, go to bed at the same time every night. Second, keep your room dark and quiet. Finally, turn off your phone an hour before bed. These small changes help many young people feel better the next day.

qs.q: Why do many students get too little sleep?
o: They wake up long before sunrise.
They study late or use phones in bed.
They have too many hard classes.
They drink too much water at night.
qs.why: because they study late or use their phones in bed라고 나와요.

qs.q: What is the third suggestion for better sleep?
o: Keep your room dark and quiet.
Go to bed at the same time.
Study until you feel very tired.
Turn off your phone an hour before bed.
qs.why: Finally 다음에 나오는 제안이 휴대폰을 자기 한 시간 전에 끄라는 거예요.

qs.q: What can a lack of sleep cause?
qs.why: A lack of sleep makes it hard to pay attention in class라고 나와요.

qs.q: The writer's purpose is to ____.
o: advertise a new kind of bed
tell a story about a doctor
qs.why: 수면 부족의 문제를 알리고 좋은 수면 습관을 제안하는 글이에요.

qs.q: In the passage, “mood” is closest in meaning to ____.
qs.why: 수면 부족이 사람의 기분(feeling)에 영향을 준다는 문맥이에요.

items.ex: Dad usually reads the news after dinner.
items.exko: 아빠는 보통 저녁 식사 후에 뉴스를 읽으세요.

items.ex: Brushing your teeth after meals is a good habit.
items.exko: 식사 후에 이를 닦는 것은 좋은 습관이에요.

items.ex: My parents leave home at seven.
